        path = cwd + '/' + path

    # Process components
    current = ''
    i = 0
    
    while i < len(components):
        comp = components[i]
        
        # Skip empty components and '.'
        if comp == '' or comp == '.':
            i += 1
            continue
        
        # Handle '..'
        if comp == '..':
            # Move to parent
            if current != '/':
                current = current.rsplit('/', 1)[0]
                if current == '':
                    current = '/'
            i += 1
            continue

        if current == '/':
            current = current + comp
        else:
            current = current + '/' + comp

        if current in links:
            links_followed += 1
            if links_followed > max_links:
                return None
            
            target = links[current]
            
            # Remaining components after current
            remaining = components[i + 1:]
            
            # Process target
            if target.startswith('/'):
                # Absolute symlink target
                current = ''
                target_components = target.split('/')
            else:
                # Relative symlink target - relative to directory containing link
                if current == '/':
                    current = ''
                else:
                    current = current.rsplit('/', 1)[0]
                target_components = target.split('/')
            
            # Combine target components with remaining components
            components = target_components + remaining
            i = 0
            continue
        
        i += 1
    
    # Return result
    if current == '':
        current = '/'
    
    return current
